articles.title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
articles.snippet: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.

articles.title: Nvidia may face a more hostile post-election Washington: Report
articles.snippet: CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with President Donald Trump probably won’t save the company from a more adversarial Washington, Semafor says.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Investigates Jensen Huang After Report He Was Target of Chinese Spy Effort
articles.snippet: Huang told staff he had been "unfaithful" to his wife, as Nvidia shares fell nearly 5% in premarket trading on Monday.
